function lin(c){ return c<=.04045?c/12.92:Math.pow((c+.055)/1.055,2.4); }
function lum(c){ return .2126*lin(c[0])+.7152*lin(c[1])+.0722*lin(c[2]); }
function at(h,s,Y){ var lo=0,hi=1; for(var i=0;i<22;i++){ var q=(lo+hi)/2; if(lum(h2r(h,s,q))>Y) hi=q; else lo=q; } return lo; }
function hsl(h,s,l,a){ return 'hsl('+Math.round(h)+' '+(s*100).toFixed(1)+'% '+(l*100).toFixed(1)+'%'+(a==null?'':' / '+a)+')'; }
function hex2hsl(x){ var r=parseInt(x.slice(1,3),16)/255, g=parseInt(x.slice(3,5),16)/255, b=parseInt(x.slice(5,7),16)/255, M=Math.max(r,g,b), n=Math.min(r,g,b), d=M-n, l=(M+n)/2, h=0;
  if(d){ h=M===r?((g-b)/d)%6:M===g?(b-r)/d+2:(r-g)/d+4; h=(h*60+360)%360; } return {h:h, s:d?d/(1-Math.abs(2*l-1)):0, y:lum([r,g,b])}; }
var TV=['--pcm-c0','--pcm-c1','--pcm-c2','--pcm-ph','--pcm-wave','--pcm-ac','--pcm-sub','--pcm-onink','--pcm-pill','--pcm-card','--pcm-hov-db','--pcm-hov-g','--pcm-ink','--pcm-line'];
function theme(){ var st=m.style, fav=H.getAttribute('data-fav'), th=parseFloat(H.style.getPropertyValue('--th')), ts=parseFloat(H.style.getPropertyValue('--ts'))||1, set=function(k,v){ st.setProperty(k,v); };
  TV.forEach(function(k){ st.removeProperty(k); }); m.classList.remove('pcm--lt');
  if(fav==null||isNaN(th)) return;
  var cc=/^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(COL[fav]||'')?hex2hsl(COL[fav]):null;
  if(cc&&1.05/(cc.y+.05)<4.5){
    var h=cc.h, s=Math.min(.72,Math.max(.22,cc.s*.72));
    m.classList.add('pcm--lt');
    set('--pcm-c0',hsl(h,s,at(h,s,.7))); set('--pcm-c1',hsl(h,s,at(h,s,.6))); set('--pcm-c2',hsl(h,s,at(h,s,.5)));
    set('--pcm-wave',hsl(h,Math.min(.9,Math.max(.35,cc.s)),.955)); set('--pcm-ph',hsl(h,s*.8,at(h,s*.8,.42)));
    set('--pcm-ink',hsl(h,.55,at(h,.55,.02))); set('--pcm-sub',hsl(h,.45,at(h,.45,.035)));
    set('--pcm-ac',hsl(h,.55,at(h,.55,.045))); set('--pcm-onink','#FFFFFF');
    set('--pcm-pill','rgba(255,255,255,.42)'); set('--pcm-card','rgba(255,255,255,.48)'); set('--pcm-hov-db','rgba(255,255,255,.72)'); set('--pcm-hov-g','rgba(255,255,255,.72)');
    set('--pcm-line',hsl(h,.5,at(h,.5,.05),.55)); return; }
  var s=Math.min(.75,.4+.3*ts), sw=Math.min(.9,.45+.45*ts), sa=Math.min(.9,.5+.35*ts);
  set('--pcm-c0',hsl(th,s,at(th,s,.115))); set('--pcm-c1',hsl(th,s,at(th,s,.05))); set('--pcm-c2',hsl(th,s*.9,at(th,s*.9,.018)));
  set('--pcm-ph',hsl(th,s*.8,at(th,s*.8,.05)));
  set('--pcm-wave',hsl(th,sw,.955)); set('--pcm-ac',hsl(th,sa,at(th,sa,.6))); set('--pcm-onink',hsl(th,.5,at(th,.5,.02)));
  set('--pcm-sub',hsl(th,.5,at(th,.5,.76)));
  set('--pcm-pill',hsl(th,.6,.72,.13)); set('--pcm-card',hsl(th,.6,.72,.11)); set('--pcm-hov-db',hsl(th,.6,.74,.2)); set('--pcm-hov-g',hsl(th,.6,.74,.18)); }
function refill(){ if(!H.classList.contains('pcm-open')) return;
  if(!box.querySelector('a')) box.innerHTML='<p class="pcm__ld">'+esc(LOADING[lang()]||LOADING.ja)+'</p>';
  setTimeout(function(){ if(!H.classList.contains('pcm-open')) return; fill(); if(!box.querySelector('a')) refill(); }, 200); }
function origin(){ var r=hb.getBoundingClientRect(); m.style.setProperty('--ox',(r.left+r.width/2)+'px'); m.style.setProperty('--oy',(r.top+r.height/2)+'px'); }
function open(o){
  if(o){ theme(); fill(); origin(); }
  H.classList.toggle('pcm-open',o); m.setAttribute('aria-hidden',String(!o)); hb.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(o)); label();
  if(o&&!box.querySelector('a')) refill();
  if(o&&byKey){ var f=box.querySelector('a'); if(f) setTimeout(function(){ f.focus({preventScroll:true}); },60); }
  if(!o&&byKey) hb.focus({preventScroll:true});
}
hb.addEventListener('click',function(e){ if(!mq.matches) return; e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation(); byKey=e.detail===0; open(!H.classList.contains('pcm-open')); },true);
m.addEventListener('click',function(e){ if(e.target.closest('a')){ open(false); return; } if(!e.target.closest('.pcm__db,.pcm__g li')) open(false); });
document.addEventListener('click',function(e){ if(!H.classList.contains('pcm-open')) return; var t=e.target; if(!t.closest||t.closest('#hb')||!t.closest('.hd')) return; byKey=false; open(false); },true);
document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
  if(!H.classList.contains('pcm-open')) return;
  if(e.key==='Escape'){ byKey=true; open(false); return; }
  if(e.key==='Tab'){ var f=[].slice.call(box.querySelectorAll('a')).concat([hb]); var i=f.indexOf(document.activeElement);
    if(e.shiftKey&&(i<=0)){ e.preventDefault(); f[f.length-1].focus(); } else if(!e.shiftKey&&i===f.length-1){ e.preventDefault(); f[0].focus(); } }
});
(mq.addEventListener?mq.addEventListener.bind(mq,'change'):mq.addListener.bind(mq))(function(){ if(!mq.matches) open(false); });
window.addEventListener('resize',function(){ if(H.classList.contains('pcm-open')) origin(); });
window.addEventListener('popstate',function(){ open(false); label(); });
try{ var mo=new MutationObserver(label); mo.observe(H,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['lang']}); if(dr) mo.observe(dr,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class']}); }catch(e){}
label();
